templateDescriptions.ai-balanced: AI-aware profile with region and service controls.
templateDescriptions.ai-strict: Fail-closed AI profile with account protections.

builderDescription: Choose routing preferences and create an opaque subscription URL that redirects to the `.ini` template.
converterDescription: Combine proxy links and subscriptions into one YAML profile for manual node selection.
excludeRegions: Use all regions except the ones I select
onlyRegions: Use only the regions I select
regionsHelpExclude: Excluded regions are removed from regional, stable, and generic node groups.
regionsHelpOnly: Only selected routable regions are candidates; unknown nodes are excluded.
preferredRegionHelp: Optional. Reorders active region choices in the manual selector; it does not enable automatic failover.
serviceHelp: Clearing a service disables its route and sends that service to REJECT.
preferredServiceHelp: Optional. Changes only the order of service selectors in generated output; it does not change where they route traffic.
allowDirectHelp: When disabled, direct choices and routes are blocked, including local and direct-routing exceptions.
failClosedHelp: Manual selectors start at REJECT, so choose a permitted route after import. Protected account safeguards remain enforced even when this option is off.
editorDraft: This configuration is a draft and has not been saved.
editorDirty: The current draft has unsaved changes.
editorInvalid: Fix the highlighted setting before previewing or saving.
editorLoadFailed: This management profile could not be loaded. Saving is disabled.
editorCreated: Profile created. Complete these steps before importing it.
previewCurrent: Preview matches the current editor settings.
previewOutdatedHelp: Routing settings changed after this preview. Preview again to review the current draft.
previewFailed: Preview could not be generated. Check the settings and try again.
saveFailed: Could not save this profile. Try again.
builderLoadFailed: The profile builder could not be loaded. Refresh and try again.
resultIntro: Your routing profile is saved. Complete both steps before using it.
resultUrlsSavedRevision: The URLs below point to the last saved revision ({revision}); unsaved edits, if any, are not included.
resultFailClosed: Fail-closed is enabled. After importing the template, choose an allowed exit in your proxy client.
intakeHint: Need a regional service that is not listed?
languageFallback: Could not load {language} strings. English is active; retry by selecting {language} again.
languageChangeFailed: Could not load {language} strings. The current language is unchanged.
subscriptionHint: Paste this URL into OpenClash subscription conversion as the Custom Template URL.
managementWarning: This link can change routing preferences. Do not share it.
onlyRequiresRegion: Only mode requires at least one routable region.
savedRevision: Saved revision {revision}. The existing subscription URL remains valid.
missingManagement: Management link is missing a profile ID or capability token.
inputFormatHelp: Paste one link per line. Auto detect combines different proxy types and approved subscription URLs. Choose “Proxy links” for HTTPS proxies. Paste Clash YAML or Base64 subscription content as one complete input.
converterInputLabel: Proxy links, subscription URLs, or pasted subscription content
inputPrivacy: Input stays in this page’s memory and is sent only to this converter. YAML may contain credentials; clear it when finished.
outputHelp: Select a node in a regional group, then choose that region in the pinned selector. With fail closed enabled, also select allowed routes for DNS and the services you use. Selections stay manual.
inputRequired: Paste a proxy link or subscription content first.
clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable. Select the text and copy it manually.
downloadFailed: The YAML download could not be started.
conversionReady: YAML ready. Node selection stays manual after import.
conversionUnavailable: The conversion service is unavailable. Try again later.
tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait briefly and try again.
conversionFailed: Could not convert this input. Check the selected type and try again.
converterErrorInvalidNode: This proxy link is invalid. Check its address, port, and format.
converterErrorUnsupportedNodeScheme: This proxy protocol is not supported.
converterErrorUnsupportedNodeOption: This proxy link uses an option this converter does not support.
converterErrorConflictingNodeOptions: This proxy link contains conflicting options.
converterErrorInvalidSubscriptionUrl: This subscription URL is not valid.
converterErrorSubscriptionRedirectReject: This subscription redirects, which is not supported.
converterErrorSubscriptionFetchFailed: This subscription could not be retrieved. Check the URL and try again.
converterErrorUnsupportedSubscriptionFor: This input does not contain a supported proxy link or subscription.
converterErrorNoNodes: No proxy nodes were found in this input.
converterErrorTooManyNodes: This input contains too many proxy nodes.
converterErrorNodeTooLarge: A proxy link exceeds the allowed size.
converterOutputStale: Input or profile settings changed. This YAML is an older snapshot; convert again before copying or downloading.
converterOutputSummary: YAML is ready. Copy or download the complete profile.
converterRequestChanged: Input or profile settings changed during conversion. Convert again to generate the current YAML.
invalidConversion: The conversion service returned an invalid result. Try again later.
networkFailed: Could not reach the conversion service. Try again later.
subscriptionHostDisabled: This subscription host is not enabled by the service operator.
serviceGroupRoutesHelp: Choose a group, assign services, and arrange exits. Preview reviews edits; creating or saving a profile, or converting to YAML, includes them.
iniTemplateScope: Generates an OpenClash custom-template subscription URL using this template.
yamlTemplateScope: Renders a YAML profile using this template and its routing options.
chooseOrCreateGroup: Choose a group or create one to begin.
deleteGroupHelp: Services in a deleted group stay blocked until assigned to another group.
groupRouteOrderHelp: Drag to set the display order of manual exit choices. Reordering does not change the selected exit or switch to another exit when one fails.
groupStartBlockedHelp: When checked, REJECT is selected on import. Choose an exit in your proxy client to allow this service.
protectedStartBlockedHelp: Required for account protection. Choose an approved exit in your proxy client after import.
globalStartBlockedHelp: Required by the global fail-closed setting. Choose an exit in your proxy client after import.
routeUnavailableService: Not allowed by this group's service policies.
allGroupRoutesAdded: All permitted exits are already in this group.
restoreServiceGroupsHelp: This replaces all edited groups, service assignments, and exit orders with the selected template.
resetGroupRoutesHelp: Replace this group's exit choices with the template defaults.
invalidGroupName: Use a unique group name that is not reserved by the template and contains no delimiters or control characters.
protectedGroupRoutes: Account protection stays separate. This group cannot be renamed, deleted, or merged; REJECT stays first and only approved exits are available.
emptyGroupRoutes: Drop an exit here. With no exits, this group rejects traffic.
emptyGroupServices: Drop services here. An empty group has no matching traffic.
incompatibleGroupRoutes: Remove exits that this service does not allow before moving it into this group.
nonlinearNavigationHelp: Open any section. Your draft stays with you.
groupNotFound: This group is no longer in your draft. Return to the group list.
templatePageHelp: Choose a starting template. You can review its defaults now or customize any section.
regionsPageHelp: Control which regional nodes are available. Display order does not enable automatic failover.
servicesPageHelp: Find a group to edit its services and manual exits. Protected account groups remain separate.
groupPageHelp: Edit this group only. Services share its manual exit choices; order is display order.
policiesPageHelp: Set service availability and global safeguards. These controls apply across groups.
reviewPageHelp: Check the current draft and resolve every issue before creating or saving.
successPageHelp: Your subscription is ready. Save both links and complete the import steps.
cancelChangesHelp: Return to the last saved settings, or the starting draft for a new profile. Your current edits can still be undone.
discardLocalDraftHelp: Delete the recovered local edits and keep the server version. This cannot be undone.
draftRevisionConflict: This local draft started at revision {localRevision}; the server is at revision {revision}. Restore it for review or discard it before saving.
draftStorageUnavailable: Draft storage is unavailable. Edits remain in this page until you reload or close the tab; they are not saved to the server.
localDraftRestored: Local draft restored in this tab. It has not been saved to the server.
localDraftExpired: The previous local draft has expired. Current server settings or template defaults are shown.
draftRestoreFailed: The local draft could not be restored. Its stored copy has been retained; current settings are shown.
reviewDraftScope: This summary describes your current draft. Previewing does not save it.
saveManagementLink: Save this link somewhere private. Anyone with it can change this profile.
capabilityLifetimeHelp: Links are shown in this tab for 30 minutes. Keep your own secure copy.
importInstructionTwo: Paste the read-only URL into Custom Template URL, then update the subscription.
importInstructionThree: Select the nodes and manual exits you intend to use.
successFailClosed: Fail-closed is enabled: traffic starts blocked after import. Manually select an allowed exit.
successUnavailable: Creation links are unavailable or have expired in this tab. Use the management link you saved.
validationSucceeded: Current draft validated. Preview matches these settings.
previewMatchesDraft: This generated preview matches the current draft. No changes have been saved by previewing.
customGroupOrderHelp: Display order follows your custom group layout. Edit each group to move it.
fallbackBlockedHelp: Unmatched traffic is blocked by the global fallback.
fallbackTemplateHelp: The global fallback follows the selected template. Service exit ordering still uses manual selection.
fallbackLegacyHelp: The saved profile retains its existing template fallback behavior.
manualOrderHelp: Display order changes where choices appear. A manual selector uses the exit you choose; it does not automatically switch when an exit fails.
savedWithNewerDraft: Revision {revision} was saved. Your newer edits are still unsaved.
saveFailedRetained: Saving failed. Your edits are still here; check the connection and try again.
managementSessionExpired: This management session expired. Your draft is retained. Reopen your saved management link to continue.
pageNotFoundHelp: Choose a configuration section to continue with your draft.
validationRegionsServer: Some region settings conflict. Select an active routable region and check its preferred order.
validationGroupsServer: Some groups have incompatible services or exits. Review assignments and the allowed exits.
validationTemplateServer: This template does not support some settings. Choose a supported template or review its options.
validationConfigurationServer: The configuration could not be validated. Check these settings and retry Preview.
atLeastOneActiveRegion: Keep at least one routable region enabled.
filterOnlyRegionsHelp: These filters can exclude nodes; they do not create a regional exit.
templateDefaultsFixed: This published template has fixed routing. Region, service, and global overrides do not apply.
templateDefaultsEditable: Region and service controls are available. Review shows the exact draft before you create a subscription.
templateOptionsUnavailable: This template uses its published routing. These overrides are not applicable. Choose another template to customize routing.
